Funding for the sequence characterization of the platyfish genome is being provided by grants to Dr. Wesley Warren, McDonnell Genome Institute, Washington University Schoold of Medicine and Dr. Ron Walter through the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and Dr. Manfred Schartl at the Universitat Wurzburg, Germany.

assembly_info.comments:
The assembly ilYpoCagn1.1 is based on 39x PacBio data and Arima2 Hi-C data generated by the Darwin Tree of Life Project
(https://www.darwintreeoflife.org/). The assembly process included the following sequence of steps: initial PacBio assembly generation with Hifiasm, retained haplotig separation with purge_dups, and Hi-C based scaffolding with YaHS. The mitochondrial genome was assembled using MitoHiFi. Finally, the primary assembly was analysed and manually improved using rapid curation. Chromosome-scale scaffolds are named by synteny based on Yponomeuta sedellus (moths) GCA_934045075.1. This heterogametic female sample appears to exhibit the sex chromosome trivalent system of n = 29A + A AW Z as described in
https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/epdf/10.1111/j.1601-5223.1988.tb00311.x . The A component of the trivalent in ilYpoCagn1 has been assigned as chromosome 27Z, this is based on its alignment to chromosome 27 in the closely related species Y.sedellus (ilYpoSedl1) which is derived from a ZZ male sample. Chromosome Z27 in ilYpoCagn1, and chromosome 27 in ilYpoSedl1 both correspond to Merian element 25.

assembly_info.comments:
The assembly ilYpoPlub1.1 is based on 30x PacBio data and Arima2 Hi-C data generated by the Darwin Tree of Life Project
(https://www.darwintreeoflife.org/). The assembly process included the following sequence of steps: initial PacBio assembly generation with Hifiasm, retained haplotig separation with purge_dups, and Hi-C based scaffolding with YaHS. The mitochondrial genome was assembled using MitoHiFi. Finally, the primary assembly was analysed and manually improved using rapid curation. Chromosome-scale scaffolds are named by synteny based on Yponomeuta sedellus (moths) GCA_934045075.1. ilYpoPlub1 is a male sample exhibiting the typical ZZ chromosome system. There is a possibility that chromosome 27 in this assembly may be an additional sex chromosome based on its alignment to 27Z in the female assemblies ilYpoCagn1 and ilYpoRore1 both of which have been found to exhibit the sex chrimosome trivalent system of n = 29A + A AW Z as described in
https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/epdf/10.1111/j.1601-5223.1988.tb00311.x . The A component of the trivalent in ilYpoCagn1 and ilYpoRore1 was assigned as chromosome 27Z based on its alignment to chromosome 27 in the closely related species Y.sedellus (ilYpoSedl1 GCA_934045075.1) which is derived from a ZZ male sample. Chromosome 27 in ilYpoPlub1 and Z27 in ilYpoCagn1 and ilYpoRore1 all correspond to Merian element 25.

assembly_info.comments:
The assembly rZooViv1.1 is based on 34x PacBio data and Arima2 Hi-C data generated by the Darwin Tree of Life Project
(https://www.darwintreeoflife.org/). The assembly process included the following sequence of steps: initial PacBio assembly generation with Hifiasm, retained haplotig separation with purge_dups, and Hi-C based scaffolding with YaHS. The mitochondrial genome was assembled using MitoHiFi. Finally, the primary assembly was analysed and manually improved using gEVAL. Chromosome-scale scaffolds confirmed by the Hi-C data have been named in order of size.

assembly_info.comments: The assembly ilZygFili1.2 is based on 58x PacBio data, 10X Genomics Chromium data, and Arima Hi-C data generated by the Darwin Tree of Life Project (https://www.darwintreeoflife.org/). The assembly process included the following sequence of steps: initial PacBio assembly generation with Hifiasm, retained haplotig separation with purge_dups, short-read polishing using FreeBayes-called variants from 10X Genomics Chromium reads aligned with LongRanger, and Hi-C based scaffolding with SALSA2. The mitochondrial genome was assembled using MitoHifi. Finally, the assembly was analysed and manually improved using gEVAL. Chromosome-scale scaffolds confirmed by the Hi-C data have been named in order of size.

assembly_info.comments: The assembly ilZygSarp1.hap1.1 is based on 115x PacBio data and Arima2 Hi-C data generated by Project Psyche (https://www.projectpsyche.org/). The assembly process included the following sequence of steps: initial PacBio assembly generation with Hifiasm in Hi-C integrated assembly mode, and Hi-C based scaffolding with YaHS. The mitochondrial genome was assembled using MitoHiFi. Finally, each haplotype assembly was analysed and manually improved using TreeVal. Chromosome-scale scaffolds confirmed by the Hi-C data have been named in order of size. The exact order and orientation of the contigs on chromosome 28 (1.9 - 2.5 Mbp) are unknown. Chromosome Z was identified by identification of ancestral Z BUSCO genes.
